build.recipe: rgbasm -I fixtures/cgb-hdma/ -o <work>/hblank.o fixtures/cgb-hdma/hblank.asm && rgblink -o <work>/hblank.gb <work>/hblank.o && rgbfix -c -v -p 0 <work>/hblank.gb; tools are isolated from the host and verified against the archive digest
build.committed_bytes_toolchain: RGBDS v1.0.1 macOS release archive (digest above); the reproduction script rebuilds the ROM with pinned tools and compares byte for byte

profile.name: CGB-CPU-E
profile.applicability: Original software fixture for the deterministic bootless CGB-CPU-E profile in CGB mode; not physical hardware evidence.

protocol.summary: The CPU starts two separate one-block HBlank DMA transfers through FF51-55, selects VRAM bank 0 then bank 1, and validates both transferred tile patterns before reporting pass.

C000.pass: 0xA5 after both FF55 status sequences and all 32 transferred bytes pass

guest_markers.C005: failure stage: 0 success, 1 first active status, 2 first completion timeout, 3 second active status, 4 second completion timeout, 5 bank 0 bytes, 6 bank 1 bytes

pixels.success_regions: Every pixel in columns 0-79 of the 160x144 frame is red RGB555 0x001F; every pixel in columns 80-159 is blue RGB555 0x7C00.
pixels.failure_regions: The no-transfer twin records C000=0xEE and keeps every pixel white RGB555 0x7FFF.
pixels.structural_predicate: Checked through the public guest marker and gbb_copy_frame_rgb555 before any fixture digest comparison.

protocol.run: Load on CGB-CPU-E; execute bounded varying half-dot partitions for ten frame budgets; inspect CPU marker/status RAM and latest complete RGB555 frame.
protocol.evidence_class: Original software fixture plus synthetic disabled-transfer control, not hardware evidence.

scope_limits: No boot ROM and no commercial ROM content
No physical CGB-E observation; source-defined pixels and guest readbacks are the oracle
No claim about mode-3 timing beyond the HBlank transfer points exercised by this guest
Not installed and not added to any package fixture allowlist
